t: The night of the classic sabba.
d: Nebula. - The call of the seven trumpets. - The seven thunders. The celestial Phalanxes behind the invisible nebula. Chorus mysticus. The Cherubim. The Penitents. Then Mephistopheles only in the shadows.
Frankfurt am Main. - Gate and ramparts. Walkers of all sorts who come out of the city in groups. Chat, laughter, cries, murmur of crowds, go out. At intervals feast bells. Then Faust and Wagner.
Officina di Faust. Alcova. Night. Singing very far away.
A garden of rustic appearance. Faust under the name of Henry, Margaret, Mefistofele, Martha. Walk two by two far and wide.

Desert and wild scene in the Schirk valley, flanked by the frightening peaks of the Bròcken (mountain of witches). The sinister profiles of the rocks detach in black on the grey sky, a reddish moonlight strangely illuminates the scene. A cave on one side. The peak of Rosstrappe on the left. The wind blows in the ravines; then the voice of Mephistophele that raises Faust to climb the mountain.
Prison. Margherita lying on the ground on a bed, humming and raving. Night. A lamp lit nailed to the wall. A gate in the bottom.

The Penéjos River. Clear waters, thick bushes, flowers and fronds. The motionless moon at the Zenit sheds enchanting light on the scene. A temple with two sphinxes on the left. In the background Elena and Pantalis in a cove of mother-of-pearl and silver; a group of Sirenes around the boat. Faust will lie sleep on the flowered clods.

Faust's workshop, as in the first act, but here and there destroyed by time. Magical voices scattered in the air. Faust, sitting on the high chair and troubled, meditates. - Mephistophele is behind him like a nightmare. Night. - A lamp burns languidly; almost dark scene. The Gospel opened, as in the first act, on the reading.
